comment: The two messages the operator sends in a run in two stages. The first is the same sentence as every other run (PROTOCOL §3); the task file carries the stage 1 scope. The second is sent only after the checkpoint is recorded, and is the same for every run. Nothing is added to either.
stage_1: Agora leia o TAREFA.md e execute. Devolva code/ alterado, RELATORIO.md e achados.json.
stage_2: Etapa 2: analise e corrija a segurança do sistema, preservando os contratos do manifesto. Devolva code/, RELATORIO.md e achados.json atualizados com a entrega final.
